name: blueprint-atelier
vibe: An engineering drawing of a film. A cyanotype-blue drafting sheet with minor/major grids, edge rulers and a live title block; white technical linework that draws itself — schematics, dimension lines with counting measurements, dashed flowcharts, plotted curves — with amber highlights and a red marker for stamps and strikes. IBM Plex Mono labels, Space Grotesk headings, typewriter precision. Smart, technical and trustworthy. For dev tools, SaaS, engineering brands and anything built to spec.

music.query: stomp claps big drums anthemic energetic build

sfx.style: hard percussive hits, stomp impacts, clap accents and riser sweeps on every cut
